mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD, REQ_NO, REQ_DT, REQ_TITL, REQ_ID, REQ_DEPT_ID, VAC_TYPE_CD, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = VAC_TYPE_CD) AS VAC_TYPE_NM, FN_CM06M01_ID_TO_NM(REQ_ID) AS REQ_ID_NM, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM04M01 WHERE DEPT_ID = REQ_DEPT_ID) AS REQ_DEPT_NM, AMPM_CD, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ST_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ED_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ST_TM, 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ST_TM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ED_TM, 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ED_TM, VAC_DAYS, DEDUCT_DAYS, REQ_RMK, SANCTN_STS, WORK_RPT_YN, FILE_TRGT_KEY, CREAT_ID, TO_CHAR(CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M01 ( CO_CD, REQ_NO, REQ_DT, REQ_TITL, REQ_ID, REQ_DEPT_ID, VAC_TYPE_CD, AMPM_CD, ST_DT, ED_DT, ST_TM, ED_TM, VAC_DAYS, DEDUCT_DAYS, REQ_RMK, SANCTN_STS, WORK_RPT_YN, FILE_TRGT_KEY, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqDeptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ampmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deductDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reqRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sanctnSts, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', #{fileTrgtKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M01 SET REQ_TITL = #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAC_TYPE_CD = #{vacTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AMPM_CD = #{ampmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ST_DT = #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ED_DT = #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ST_TM = #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ED_TM = #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAC_DAYS = #{vacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DEDUCT_DAYS = #{deductDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REQ_RMK = #{reqRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDT_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDT_PGM = 'PM0701P01', UPDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND REQ_NO = #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.select: SELECT GRANT_DAYS - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_ID = #{userId} AND YY = #{yy} AND SANCTN_STS = 'END'), 0) AS BALANCE FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT GRANT_DAYS AS grantDays, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(TO_DATE(REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = TO_NUMBER(#{yy}) AND SANCTN_STS = 'END'), 0) AS usedDays, GRANT_DAYS - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(TO_DATE(REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = TO_NUMBER(#{yy}) AND SANCTN_STS = 'END'), 0) AS balanceDays FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M02 ( CO_CD, YY, USER_ID, GRANT_DAYS, AUTO_YN, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{coCd}, #{yy}, #{userId}, #{grantDays}, #{autoYn}, #{rmk}, #{userId}, 'PM0701M01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M02 SET GRANT_DAYS = #{grantDays}, AUTO_YN = #{autoYn}, RMK = #{rmk}, UPDT_ID = #{userId}, UPDT_PGM = 'PM0701M01', UPDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD, YY, USER_ID, GRANT_DAYS, AUTO_YN, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
